lines.text: The LORD forbids idols, carved images and sculpted stones, and tells Israel to keep His Sabbaths and revere His sanctuary.
If Israel obeys, the LORD will give rains in their season, and five of them will pursue a hundred enemies.
The LORD reminds Israel that He brought them out of Babylon so they would no longer be slaves.
If Israel keeps walking in hostility, the LORD says He will send swarms of locusts against them to rob them of their children.
If their hearts are humbled, the LORD will remember His covenant with Jacob, Isaac and Abraham, and He will remember the land.
